title: Dark Mode Theme Toggle
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Write a complete HTML file with embedded CSS that implements a dark and light theme system using CSS custom properties. Define light theme variables under `:root` and dark theme overrides under `[data-theme="dark"]`. Build a page with a `.container`, a `.card`, and a checkbox toggle that switches `data-theme` on the `html` element. All colors in the page must come from the CSS variables, except within the variable definitions.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Return a single HTML file with embedded CSS
- Use CSS custom properties for all colors
- Define dark theme overrides on `[data-theme="dark"]`
- Include a working checkbox toggle with minimal JavaScript
- Do not hardcode colors outside the variable definitions

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
